items.html: It turns out that since Adam ha Rishon was created from the place of his repentance, the Olam was always in the form of Beria. After he had sinned, he was created in the weekdays. We have already explained in Parashat Pekudei that Adam ha Rishon was created by Zivug ZA and its Nukva, who rose up to the Heichal of Abba ve Ima where they mated Panim be Panim and procreated Adam and Hava.
